entries.name: Cutebot
entries.description: ELECFREAKS Cutebot chassis driver for the micro:bit (v2): drive, turn, pivot, stop, and directional steer tiles, plus the two-side line-tracking sensor.

entries.name: Yahboom Gamepad
entries.description: Yahboom GHBit gamepad driver for the micro:bit (v2): the thumb-stick direction and continuous position sensors, the colored-button sensor, the received-packet decoder, and the position-to-packet radio encoding.
